question: What screen or touch-response issues do iPhone X reviewers describe?
contexts: Ghost touch issue when first received. The phone is good it just came with the ghost touch issue. For those that don’t know the iPhone X some times does movements on its own without you touching the screen. I’ve tried everything and nothing seems to work. I’ve emailed about a replacement but I’ve haven’t gotten a response yet

Unexpected Touchscreen Issues. While the iPhone X provides numerous features that are improvements over the previous models, it exhibits some problems with touchscreen functioning while the battery is charging. This results in one of two undesired behaviors: 1) Portions of the screen not responding to touch. This is usually in the upper corners. 2) Greatly delayed response to touch such that the screen does not appear to respond at all followed by periods where the screen seems to be under the control of some outside force because multiple actions take place in rapid succession that completely ignore any actual touch commands being made in the moment. Best response is achieved by limiting interaction while the phone is charging.

answer:
One reviewer reported that their iPhone X arrived with a ghost touch issue, where the phone sometimes makes movements on its own without the screen being touched. [26deef7702ed_0]
Another reviewer described touchscreen problems while the battery is charging, including portions of the screen, usually the upper corners, not responding to touch. [e97889031da1_0]
That same reviewer also described greatly delayed touch response followed by rapid multiple actions that ignored actual touch commands, and said limiting interaction while charging gave the best response. [e97889031da1_0]
One reviewer said the phone had ghost touch, which they called a common iPhone X issue, and that Apple fixed it for free. [35f5efd0e4af_0]
Another reviewer said the phone worked great for a month and then the screen went out. [cc4967ade82e_0]
In contrast, one reviewer said the phone came in perfect working condition with no issues and was happy with the screen performance. [c9c8d7ada44b_0]
